note: Mission-fit table (F8A Task 10, 2026-10-16): hand-transcribed from F3 section 4, one row per chapter. A 'filled' row has a start, a first-action point and a cruise speed in world terms and is checked by tests/sim/missionFit.test.ts against the real site layout within `ceilingS` at 1x; a 'pending' row names the F8 plan that closes it and why. A failing row is a finding to report, never to tune (Mark, 2026-10-16).
